product.olivetti-m24-new-p75.summary: The 75 MHz Pentium configuration that revived the M24 name in a slim case.
product.olivetti-m24-new-p75.history: Olivetti reused the M24 name for a Pentium range based on the M4-Pxx and PCS 51xx.
product.olivetti-m24-new-p75.architectur: The board integrates video and disk control. The guide lists BA2280 and BA2284 with Trident TGUI9680-1 and two Fast IDE drive connections.
product.olivetti-m24-new-p75.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-m24-new-p75.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-m24-new-p75.service-gui: Olivetti, Personal Computer – Pocket Service Guide, vol. II, ch. 21
product.olivetti-m24-new-p75.firmware: The revision helps identify the service BIOS. The guide lists 1.21.
